# NexoMind

> A quieter way to think — private AI journaling with no streaks, no scores. One calm reflection when your head is loud.

NexoMind is an AI journaling app that helps you process thoughts in the moment. Write whatever's on your mind and AI gently reflects it back as emotional patterns, themes, and a single grounded takeaway. Private by design — entries are encrypted, never sold, never used to train models.

## Tools

- [Overthinking Analyzer](/overthinking-analyzer): Free interactive tool. Paste a looping thought and get a four-part reflection — Trigger, Thought loop, Distortion, Clarity. No signup, not stored, runs in the browser.
